title: Does AI for science need another ImageNet Or totally different benchmarks? A case study of machine learning force fields
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking machine learning force fields (MLFF) for scientific computing tasks, specifically molecular dynamics simulations. It discusses technical challenges in benchmarking such as sample efficiency, time-series extrapolation, and cross-molecule generalization. It does not contain content related to evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics.
